method: Read-only production queries; first three SQL statements exactly as supplied by user

requested_rating_history.sql:
SELECT min(effective_date), max(effective_date), count(*)
FROM trusted_event_ledger WHERE event_type = 'rating_changed'

requested_london_homecare_90d.sql:
SELECT count(*) AS events, count(DISTINCT t.provider_id) AS orgs
FROM trusted_event_ledger t
JOIN care_providers cp ON cp.id = t.location_id
WHERE t.event_type = 'rating_changed'
  AND t.effective_date >= current_date - 90
  AND cp.region = 'London'
  AND cp.service_types ILIKE ANY (ARRAY['%domiciliary%', '%homecare%'])

requested_london_ri_inspection_years.sql:
SELECT left(last_inspection_date::text, 4) AS yr, count(*)
FROM care_providers
WHERE region = 'London' AND overall_rating ILIKE 'requires improvement'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

london_ri_cohort_sizes.sql:
SELECT count(*) AS all_london_ri_locations,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE service_types ILIKE ANY (ARRAY['%domiciliary%','%homecare%'])) AS london_homecare_ri_locations,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE upper(status)='ACTIVE') AS active_london_ri_locations,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE upper(status)='ACTIVE' AND service_types ILIKE ANY (ARRAY['%domiciliary%','%homecare%'])) AS active_london_homecare_ri_locations
FROM care_providers WHERE region='London' AND overall_rating ILIKE 'requires improvement'

london_ri_rating_events_12m.sql:
SELECT count(*) AS events,count(DISTINCT t.location_id) AS locations,count(DISTINCT t.provider_id) AS organisations
 FROM trusted_event_ledger t JOIN care_providers cp ON cp.id=t.location_id
 WHERE cp.region='London' AND cp.overall_rating ILIKE 'requires improvement'
 AND t.event_type='rating_changed' AND t.effective_date>=current_date-365

london_homecare_ri_rating_events_12m.sql:
SELECT count(*) AS events,count(DISTINCT t.location_id) AS locations,count(DISTINCT t.provider_id) AS organisations
 FROM trusted_event_ledger t JOIN care_providers cp ON cp.id=t.location_id
 WHERE cp.region='London' AND cp.overall_rating ILIKE 'requires improvement'
 AND cp.service_types ILIKE ANY (ARRAY['%domiciliary%','%homecare%'])
 AND t.event_type='rating_changed' AND t.effective_date>=current_date-365

rating_dates_and_observation_depth.sql:
SELECT count(*) AS events,
 count(effective_date) AS with_effective_date,count(effective_at) AS with_effective_at,
 min(observed_at) AS first_observed,max(observed_at) AS last_observed,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE old_value::text IN ('"Good"','"Outstanding"','"Requires improvement"','"Inadequate"') AND new_value::text IN ('"Good"','"Outstanding"','"Requires improvement"','"Inadequate"')) AS grade_to_grade_events
 FROM trusted_event_ledger WHERE event_type='rating_changed'

national_90d_rating_events.sql:
SELECT count(*) AS events,count(DISTINCT t.provider_id) AS organisations
 FROM trusted_event_ledger t JOIN care_providers cp ON cp.id=t.location_id
 WHERE t.event_type='rating_changed' AND t.effective_date>=current_date-90
 AND cp.region IN ('London','South East','South West','East','East Midlands','West Midlands','North West','North East','Yorkshire & Humberside')

london_ri_publication_years.sql:
SELECT extract(year FROM last_published_rating_date)::int AS yr,count(*) AS locations,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE service_types ILIKE ANY (ARRAY['%domiciliary%','%homecare%'])) AS homecare_locations
 FROM care_providers WHERE region='London' AND overall_rating ILIKE 'requires improvement' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

london_ri_publication_recency.sql:
SELECT count(*) AS locations,
 count(last_published_rating_date) AS with_publication_date,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE last_published_rating_date>=current_date-365) AS publication_within_12m,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE last_published_rating_date>=current_date-90) AS publication_within_90d,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE last_published_rating_date>last_inspection_date) AS publication_later_than_inspection,
 max(last_published_rating_date) AS newest_publication,max(last_inspection_date) AS newest_inspection
 FROM care_providers WHERE region='London' AND overall_rating ILIKE 'requires improvement'

national_social_care_registration_90d.sql:
SELECT count(*) AS events,count(DISTINCT t.location_id) AS locations,count(DISTINCT t.provider_id) AS organisations
 FROM trusted_event_ledger t JOIN care_providers cp ON cp.id=t.location_id
 WHERE t.event_type='new_registration' AND t.effective_date>=current_date-90
 AND cp.type='Social Care Org' AND upper(cp.status)='ACTIVE'

london_homecare_registration_90d.sql:
SELECT count(*) AS events,count(DISTINCT t.location_id) AS locations,count(DISTINCT t.provider_id) AS organisations
 FROM trusted_event_ledger t JOIN care_providers cp ON cp.id=t.location_id
 WHERE t.event_type='new_registration' AND t.effective_date>=current_date-90
 AND cp.region='London' AND cp.service_types ILIKE ANY (ARRAY['%domiciliary%','%homecare%'])
 AND upper(cp.status)='ACTIVE'

sample_115_dates.sql: SELECT count(*) AS matched_locations,count(DISTINCT provider_id) AS provider_organisations,count(last_published_rating_date) AS with_publication_date,count(*) FILTER(WHERE last_published_rating_date>last_inspection_date) AS publication_later_than_inspection,count(*) FILTER(WHERE last_inspection_date IS NULL AND last_published_rating_date IS NOT NULL) AS missing_inspection_but_publication_present,count(*) FILTER(WHERE last_published_rating_date>=current_date-365) AS published_within_12m,max(last_published_rating_date) AS newest_publication,max(last_inspection_date) AS newest_inspection FROM care_providers WHERE id=ANY(%s)

sample_115_publication_years.sql: SELECT extract(year FROM last_published_rating_date)::int AS yr,count(*) AS locations FROM care_providers WHERE id=ANY(%s) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

sample_115_events_observed_vs_effective.sql: SELECT count(*) AS rating_event_rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE t.effective_date>=current_date-365) AS recent_effective_rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE t.observed_at>=now()-interval '365 days') AS recent_observed_rows,count(DISTINCT t.location_id) AS locations_with_observed_rating_event,count(*) FILTER(WHERE t.old_value::text IN ('"Good"','"Outstanding"','"Requires improvement"','"Inadequate"') AND t.new_value::text IN ('"Good"','"Outstanding"','"Requires improvement"','"Inadequate"')) AS grade_to_grade_rows FROM trusted_event_ledger t WHERE t.location_id=ANY(%s) AND t.event_type='rating_changed'

london_homecare_registrations_provenance.sql: SELECT count(*) AS events,count(DISTINCT t.provider_id) AS organisations,count(DISTINCT t.provider_id) FILTER(WHERE t.source_url IS NOT NULL AND t.source_snapshot_sha256 IS NOT NULL AND t.effective_date IS NOT NULL) AS organisations_with_url_hash_date FROM trusted_event_ledger t JOIN care_providers cp ON cp.id=t.location_id WHERE t.event_type='new_registration' AND t.effective_date>=current_date-90 AND cp.region='London' AND cp.service_types ILIKE ANY(ARRAY['%domiciliary%','%homecare%']) AND upper(cp.status)='ACTIVE'

public_source_spotcheck_candidates.sql: SELECT id,last_inspection_date,last_published_rating_date,inspection_report_url FROM care_providers WHERE id=ANY(%s) ORDER BY last_published_rating_date DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 3

grade_transition_candidates_all_history.sql: SELECT old_value::text AS old_rating,new_value::text AS new_rating,effective_date,observed_at,count(*) AS events FROM trusted_event_ledger WHERE event_type='rating_changed' AND old_value::text IN ('"Good"','"Outstanding"','"Requires improvement"','"Inadequate"') AND new_value::text IN ('"Good"','"Outstanding"','"Requires improvement"','"Inadequate"') GROUP BY 1,2,3,4

national_social_care_registration_proven.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT t.provider_id) AS organisations,count(DISTINCT t.provider_id) FILTER(WHERE t.source_url IS NOT NULL AND t.source_snapshot_sha256 IS NOT NULL AND t.effective_date IS NOT NULL) AS organisations_with_url_hash_date FROM trusted_event_ledger t JOIN care_providers cp ON cp.id=t.location_id WHERE t.event_type='new_registration' AND t.effective_date>=current_date-90 AND cp.type='Social Care Org' AND upper(cp.status)='ACTIVE'
